ma-county-officials.summary: The County card says which form of government the county has, and names none of its commissioners, sheriff or registers of deeds. Eight of the fourteen counties have no county government.
ma-county-officials.why: No list of Massachusetts's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
ma-county-officials.wanted: A list of each county's commissioners or regional government, its sheriff and its registers of deeds, from the state or from the county itself.

ma-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its mayor, council or select board.
ma-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Massachusetts's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ma-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's or town's mayor, council or select board, or a city's or town's own published list of them.

ma-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school committee.
ma-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Massachusetts's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ma-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ma-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
ma-tribal-government.why: This app has not read any Massachusetts nation's council list yet. Each nation publishes its own, which has to be read one nation at a time.
ma-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.
